findings.issue: Import modal polling effect doesn't guard against setState after unmount. The cleanup clears the interval but in-flight getImportStatus promises can still call setImportStatus. Add mounted flag in useEffect, check before setState.
GitHub callback state update after unmount issue was fixed in recent diff (mounted flag added), but should be verified in testing.
OAuth popup may be blocked by browser, but window.open return value isn't checked. Show toast error if popup is null so user knows popup was blocked.
Debounce cleanup missing mounted guard. setTimeout is cleared but performSearch async function can call setResults/setLoading after unmount. Add mounted flag in search effect.
Code block regex /```(\w+)?\n([\s\S]*?)```/g doesn't handle escaped backticks or nested code examples. Either document limitation or use parser library.

Clipboard API copy button fails silently in non-HTTPS contexts (navigator.clipboard unavailable). Check if API is available before calling writeText, show toast error or disable button if unavailable.
Projects array always empty (initialized as empty array with no fetch logic). Search panel non-functional until projects are loaded. Wire projectService.listProjects or remove project selector.
Modal width uses window.innerWidth < 768 evaluated once on render. Doesn't update on resize. Use CSS media queries or add resize listener.

summary: Phase 4 frontend integration is substantially complete with 47 files changed (29 added, 18 modified) across 5 features. Build succeeds, routes configured, responsive layouts implemented. Critical issues: 4 components missing mounted guards for async setState (import modal, semantic search), projects array empty blocking search functionality, clipboard API fails silently in non-HTTPS. Non-critical: popup blocker detection, code block regex limitations, modal resize handling. All 20 tasks from phase4-plan.md implemented, acceptance criteria mostly met, but cleanup patterns need hardening before production.
